Porting web-native-skeleton's `scripts/audit-gate.mjs` stays unboarded here for the same reason it is unboarded upstream (new drain ceremony/tooling, forbidden by Martin's 2026-07-14 'drains narrow to security/correctness' ruling). Do NOT read a green line into this file's existence. It carries the ARGUMENT for each accepted residue in the shape ADR 0031 defined, so the reasoning survives where the next person hits the same red. Verify with `pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high` and compare against the entries below. MEASURED IN THIS TREE 2026-07-28: 9 vulnerabilities (2 low, 5 moderate, 2 high) — the two high advisories are exactly the two below, matching upstream. PERIMETRA DELTA: this tree also carries two overrides upstream does not (`brace-expansion@2`, `form-data`, both reaching in via `@miklik1/cardo-tax-cz`); they clear their own advisories in place and are therefore not residues, but they are why perimetra's override block is wider than the skeleton's.

advisories.reason: brace-expansion 1.1.16 (the newest v1 release). The advisory range is <=5.0.7 and the only patched version is >=5.0.8, so there is NO fix on the v1 line and 'upgrade' means a forced major. That major is API-INCOMPATIBLE with the only consumer here, measured IN THIS TREE (2026-07-28): brace-expansion@5.0.8's CommonJS build exports a NAMED expand (`typeof require('brace-expansion')` is `object`, `.expand` is the function), while minimatch@3.1.5 does `var expand = require('brace-expansion')` and calls it directly — which throws `TypeError: expand is not a function`. An override would trade a build-tooling DoS for a broken test toolchain. Reach: every flagged path is apps/mobile > @expo/log-box > expo > @expo/cli > react-native > @react-native/jest-preset > babel-jest > babel-plugin-istanbul > test-exclude > (glob >) minimatch, i.e. Jest coverage-instrumentation glob matching at TEST time, over brace patterns this repo authors — not a runtime path, not attacker-controlled input. The `brace-expansion@1: ^1.1.16` and `brace-expansion@5: ^5.0.8` overrides in pnpm-workspace.yaml are kept regardless: they clear GHSA-3jxr-9vmj-r5cp and fix the v5 line in place. RECHECK at expiry: has the expo/jest chain moved off minimatch@3, or has brace-expansion backported a v1 patch. Same residue, same argument, same expiry as web-native-skeleton ADR 1033 — the two trees share the expo/jest chain, so they will clear together or not at all.

@opentelemetry/propagator-jaeger 2.7.1 — JaegerPropagator throws an unhandled exception on a malformed `uber-trace-id` header. A patched 2.10.0 exists, and an override to it was TRIED, MEASURED and REVERTED on 2026-07-28: 2.10.0 declares `@opentelemetry/core: 2.10.0` EXACTLY (not a caret), so forcing it installs a SECOND OTel core alongside the 2.7.1 that `@opentelemetry/sdk-node@0.218.0` and every other package in the catalog resolve — verified in the installed tree, both `@opentelemetry+core@2.7.1` and `@opentelemetry+core@2.10.0` present with propagator-jaeger symlinked to the latter. Two cores means two copies of the context-propagation machinery and the global registration state, which is a SILENT correctness hazard worse than the DoS it would fix. (This confirms the W15 judgement rather than overturning it; the W15 note recorded the same conclusion and this wave re-measured it.) Reach: JaegerPropagator is instantiated ONLY when `OTEL_PROPAGATORS` names `jaeger` (sdk-node build/src/utils.js propagator factory map); this tree never sets it, so the default `tracecontext,baggage` applies and the vulnerable class is never constructed. THE REAL FIX is moving the whole `0.218.0` otel catalog set (sdk-node + the two exporters + instrumentation + instrumentation-pg/ioredis/pino) to a release line whose sdk-node itself pins core >= 2.9.0 — one core, no override. That is a versioned-set dependency bump, not a one-line lever, and it is the recheck to run at expiry. A derived project that DOES set `OTEL_PROPAGATORS=jaeger` must not wait for the expiry: do the catalog bump. See ADR 1048.
